messages:
sara: RFC follow-up / lightweight 'fallback-lens' idea: normalize variant signals into a single score so router has one decision input. keep it tiny.

ben: single score could hide signal nuance. what fields?

sara: score plus provenance tags. envelope: {score, confidence, source, epoch_ms}. score in [-1..1] where negative favors fallback. router policy maps score ranges to actions.

kai: dedupe plan? multiple infra adapters may emit same event.

sara: attach source_id+seq and use a short dedupe window (200ms). also require consensus: at least 2 sources or sample_count>min before eject.

ben: ops needs immediate manual eject. ops-bypass?

sara: yes: /rollouts/{id}/latch?action=eject. router honors latch instantly and emits a priority alert.

kai: perf?

sara: fastpath in router, pure in-memory ring buffer. microbench <100ns per envelope.

ops-bot: checklist created: https://internal.redwood/ops/checks/FL-02 (auto).

ben: next steps: add RFC appendix with API stubs + sample policy + shadow mode plan. will review by Tue EOD.
